Ben M.: FYI Amir handed in his resignation today, last day 2025-12-12. Can we sync on benefits cutoff, laptop return, and SSO deprovision window?
Priya (People Ops): Thanks Ben. We'll need to confirm Amir's benefits end date and COBRA packet. Amanda from benefits will send the 60-day COBRA notice. Amir, can you confirm preferred personal email for benefits/COBRA?
Amir: sure — personal: amir.personal@gmail.com
Priya (People Ops): Got it. Benefits themselves typically run through termination date (12/12). COBRA election window = 60 days after coverage end. We'll email the packet by EOD tomorrow.
Kofi (Payroll): Heads up: final paycheck will be processed on next payroll run after 12/12. PTO payout per policy; fill out the PTO balance form here: https://hr.redwood.com/pto-form
Marcus (IT): For access removal, standard cadence is: remove VPN & tokens same day after EOD, SSO deprovision 24 hours after last day unless manager requests earlier. Marcus: please confirm any blocked service keys that belong to Amir.
Ben M.: Need a 48h overlap on a few scheduled calls but can move them. Prefer SSO deprovision early AM 12/13 so we don't have mid-day disruption.
Marcus (IT): OK we can schedule deprovision 2025-12-13 9:00 UTC. I'll also collect assets — please provide serial# for the laptop if you have it.
Amir: laptop serial is SN-7F4K2L, docking station + power brick included. I'll drop the device at SF office reception by 12/15 if that's easier.
Lina (Facilities): Drop-off at reception is fine. If shipping is needed, use this label: https://facilities.redwood.com/return-labels 
Jenna (Security): Quick security note: Amir has two service keys in KeyVault (k-ml-model-a, k-ci-runner). We need to rotate those keys and update any dependents before deprovision. Marcus can you run rotation and add a short changelog in the ticket?
Marcus (IT): yep — I'll rotate keys and ping the oncall owners. Will attach the commands in the ticket. Example deprovision snippet for records:
```
./deprovision_user.sh --user=amir --revoke-vpn --remove-sso
kv rotate k-ml-model-a
kv rotate k-ci-runner
```
Priya (People Ops): Also scheduling an exit interview — 30 min with People Ops + optional manager. Proposed slot 2025-12-10 11:00 PT. Amir, does that work?
Amir: 12/10 11:00 PT works for me.
Kofi (Payroll): One more: international tax/visa team — Amir's work authorization paperwork needs to be closed out. People Ops, can you loop in Legal/Immigration? If not closed before last day, there are additional forms.
Priya (People Ops): On it. Looping in Legal via email now. Also note: if Amir elects COBRA, billing starts on the first of the month after election — we'll include sample costs in the packet.
Ben M.: Appreciate the quick coordination. I'll prepare a short knowledge-transfer doc for the coverage owner and drop it in the #eng-docs channel.
Amir: I'll upload handover notes by EOD 12/05 and share runbook links.
Marcus (IT): Created ticket #IT-4821 with checklist (SSO, VPN, key rotation, laptop inventory, cloud creds). I'll update with timestamps when actions occur.
Jenna (Security): After deprovision, I'll run an access audit and send a brief report.
Priya (People Ops): Summary of next steps: 1) Benefits/COBRA packet to Amir by EOD tomorrow; 2) Payroll to process final check after 12/12 and confirm PTO payout; 3) IT rotates keys and schedules deprovision 12/13 09:00 UTC; 4) Amir drops laptop at reception by 12/15; 5) Exit interview 12/10 11:00 PT. If anyone needs to change timing please reply here. :thumbsup:
